name: Glaiving raises Fury Unleashed's damage and lowers its Energy cost (#2015)
contract: Since owner ruling O-33 (Felsworn ADR 0027) Fury Unleashed's damage sub-spell 555739 carries 806095's 200% (effect 0 base 199 resolved 200) and Glaiving 560578 raises its damage through a 50% SPELLMOD_DAMAGE percent modifier, not a flat SPELLMOD_EFFECT1, so the effect 0 value reads 200 with and without Glaiving (the damage rise is judged by the conformance entry 560578 hit_ratio damage); Glaiving reduces Fury Unleashed's cast (555738, 60 Energy) cost via a -51 (resolved -50%) SPELLMOD_COST percentage modifier (aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, not a flat op).
